description: Returns the node the Webcake editor drops for a type, in the sparse authoring shape: a fresh id, the editor default look (colours, font, border, size) and settings for both breakpoints, and its default children (a form with name + phone fields and a submit button, a carousel with slides, a grid with items). Images are sized placeholders to replace. properties, runtime, empty events and per-breakpoint config are omitted because the server fills them from factory defaults on validate and save.
name: new_element
